title: Persons permitted to make the offer and to counsel
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.18(1) a pharmacist or a pharmacist's designee shall offer the counseling services of the pharmacist to each person who receives a prescription medication, and under 247 CMR 9.18(2) a pharmacist shall ensure his or her designee is appropriately trained to make the offer to counsel. Under 247 CMR 9.18(3) counseling shall be made by a pharmacist or a pharmacy intern, and a pharmacy technician or other individual may not counsel any patient.
exam_relevance: Tests the split between who may extend the offer and who may deliver the counseling, and that an intern may counsel while a technician may not.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: A designee may make the offer but a technician may never provide the counseling itself.
A pharmacy intern may counsel; the bar applies to technicians and other individuals.
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-B authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
